scenarios._doc: Encounters are the fights we sim; tabs are the rankings shown on the page. One sim gives every metric, so tabs that share an encounter share their screening sims. Metrics: tps, dps, dtps, tmi (lower is better), cod (chance of death, lower is better).

single.label: Raid boss
single._note: The engine's default raid target (level 63, 2601 base melee, 2.0 s swing), as the site and the Paladin/Warrior setups use. The Bear maintainers' 'Mount Hyjal' preset uses 6000 base damage instead; set minBaseDamage here to try that.

multi.label: Trash pack (4 mobs)
multi._note: Assumption: four level 62 elites hitting for about 1100 before mitigation, all on the tank, 60 s pulls.

scenarios._tuning: screen: every candidate once vs the starting gear; search: the slot-by-slot search; final: the numbers shown. suffixesPerMetric: random suffixes kept per item per metric (by the engine-measured stat weights). weightKeepPerSlot: plain items (no proc, on-use or set) kept per slot per metric by stat weights before screening.
scenarios._minQuality: 3 = rare (blue) and up: greens and below are left out.

pvp.originalRankPattern: ^(Private|Corporal|Sergeant|Master Sergeant|Sergeant Major|Knight|Knight-Lieutenant|Knight-Captain|Knight-Champion|Lieutenant Commander|Commander|Marshal|Field Marshal|Grand Marshal|Scout|Grunt|Senior Sergeant|First Sergeant|Stone Guard|Blood Guard|Legionnaire|Centurion|Champion|Lieutenant General|General|Warlord|High Warlord)'s
pvp._rankCap: 8: the cap players can have reached before raids open on 9 December 2026 (season week 6 if season 1 began at launch, which opens rank 9 only on 8 December US / 9 December EU; week 5 and rank 8 if it began at the first reset). Premier rares need no rank.

scenarios._pvp: Forever PvP (datamined, Icy Veins / Lore Forever / Conquest Capped): the Premier rare set needs no rank; epic upgrades unlock by rank per slot (epicRankBySlot). The weekly cap allows rank 3,5,6,7,8,9,11,12,13,14 in season weeks 1-10, so rankCap 9 is the most reachable by 9 December if season 1 began at launch (4 November). Original-game rank sets are not sold in Forever.
scenarios._finalRankKeep: Final rankings run in two stages: every shortlisted item and obtainable enchant against the BiS set at search iterations, then the best finalRankKeep items (enchantRankKeep enchants) per slot, plus anything within two standard errors of the last, at final iterations. The page shows the top 8.
